C0389.title: SEC Suspends Trading in 255 Dormant Shell Companies
C0389.summary: The U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission launched "Operation Shell Expel," temporarily suspending trading in the securities of 255 dormant shell companies. These companies lacked ongoing operations and were highly susceptible to being misused for fraudulent purposes.

references.title: SEC Continues Microcap Fraud Crackdown, Proactively Suspends
